content: We need to extract SMILES of unknown sample. We have tools to get spectra, mass spec, etc. But we need to deduce structure. However we can also search NMRShift database? But we don't know SMILES. We need to infer from data. But we have no data provided yet. We need to request measurements. Since expensive, we should start with mass spectrometry to get molecular weight and formula. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool.
